objective: Determine whether public BTC/USD fills from the frozen Wolfpack remain profitable when copied prospectively on Ostium with observable delay and executable small-account prices.
mechanism: Persistent trader skill is useful only if it survives publication latency and our execution. Concurrent Ostium and Hyperliquid BTC state is explanatory context and a future falsifiable conditioning variable, not a hindsight entry filter in v38.

paper_contract.entry: first Ostium executable quote captured after a public source Open fill
paper_contract.exit: first Ostium executable quote captured after the corresponding public Close, StopLoss, TakeProfit, Liquidation or CloseDayTrade fill
paper_contract.execution_price: Ostium SDK simulated slippage for 250 USDC when present; otherwise bid/ask fallback marked non-final
paper_contract.fees: observed Ostium open and close fees
paper_contract.raw_data_policy: addresses, fills and venue snapshots remain outside Git; persist only hashes, aggregates and transformative evidence

cross_venue_context.selection_boundary: v38 cannot select trades using cross-venue fields; after forward coverage they may define a separately preregistered v39 filter

automatic_reject: copied net PnL is non-positive after 30 closed copies
source profits disappear after observable latency and executable prices
profit is concentrated beyond the frozen limit
paper execution realism cannot be completed
requires retroactively changing the frozen cohort
